simple.meaning: רֹב (rôb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “abundance (in any respect).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 150 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 16:10. Its contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רֹב (H7230).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רֹב (rôb) / H7230 is traced through Genesis 16:10, Genesis 27:28, Genesis 30:30, Genesis 32:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.
